info.name: CLD376 - Member 2 (Registration, Work Orders, Repair Notes)
info.description:
Member 2 requests. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner).

1. Set gateway (click the collection, Variables tab): http://localhost:3000 locally, or http://<EC2-1 public IP>:3000.
2. Run scripts/seed-users.js once so the five test users exist.
3. Run folder 0 first: it logs in and saves every token and user id. Ids of created records are saved automatically by each request test script.
4. Folder 1 uses Member 1 Vehicles and Bookings services, so those must be running.
